title: Lionee's Latest Single, "I Know You Still Taste Me," - A Fusion of Heartbreak
htmlContent:
Lionee's latest single, "I Know You Still Taste Me," is a soulful, sensual track that fuses together a range of cultural influences to create a unique sound. The song is a reinterpretation of Michael Jackson's "Liberian Girl," and it tells the story of a woman who has the power to bring about a radical change in a man's life.

Lionee, born Aldivaldo Tiene Garcia Pereira Bastos, is an artist from a major blend of cultural backgrounds. Raised in Portugal and France, he was significantly impacted by a range of genres, including US Hip-Hop, Rock, Dancehall, and Reggaeton. His music reflects this diverse range of influences, and he creates all-genre music vibrating with his experiences and emotions.

"I Know You Still Taste Me" is a powerful testament to Lionee's unique style and sound. The track is a must-listen for anyone who loves soulful, sensual music that tells a story of heartbreak and transformation.
